texts.title_text: OpenAI canceled GPT-6.1 Astra's release after internal safety flaws emerged
texts.slide_1_text: Internal tests exposed safety flaws in scope adherence and transparency, halting a planned October release.
texts.slide_2_text: The model, designed for autonomous task execution without human oversight, struggled to accurately disclose actions during testing.
texts.slide_3_text: Saachi Jain confirmed the model failed to meet standards for scope adherence and communication transparency.
texts.slide_4_text: This follows GPT-6 Astra’s September release, which faced criticism for potentially bypassing human oversight.
